name: Truck Sim World
desc:
Welcome driver! 🚚 

Truck Sim World is the most realistic trucking experience on Roblox! 
After months of development we are more than thrilled to deliver the biggest truck simulator to all the fans on Roblox!

 - 🏞 Deliver Cargo around the map inspired on Germany!
 - 🎉Enhance your trucks with additional accessories and tuning items! 
- 🌏Explore the enormous map!
 - 🧑 Meet other truckers! 
- 🚚 Join massive Convoys all around Germany!

 The game is in Beta! 

😳 UPDATE! 😳
DEVLOG 10.09.2024
VERSION 1.2

CHANGES
- Added Day/Night Cycle!
- Trucks now have working lights and blinkers!
- Located and fixed a bug causing long loading times on some devices!
